ticket.title: storypole list hides archived tickets without saying so, so an all-archived store reads as empty
ticket.description:
storypole list hides archived tickets and says nothing about it. A store whose tickets are all archived prints "No tasks found matching filter criteria" - identical to a store with no tickets, an unreadable store, or one whose index failed to build. Measured 2026-11-10 during GB-347: dado holds 3 tickets, all archived, and lists as empty; --include-archived shows all 3; batten behaves the same way with its 1 ticket; rabbet lists because it has unarchived rows. The filter is documented in --help but the output gives the operator no way to tell "hidden by filter" from "store is empty", which is why it was read as a store-health defect during the remint and written into GB-347 as one. Fix is small: print the hidden count when rows were filtered out. Filed at the harness because CO-1 is still owned by common until the GB-347 remint lands; this is storypole-CLI work and should be reminted into storypole with the rest.

FIXED 2026-11-10. `storypole list` now counts what the filter hid and says so:

  3 archived ticket(s) hidden by this view; --include-archived lists them

  and in `--json`: `{"count": 3, "archived_hidden": 3, "tasks": [...]}`.

The count is one extra query against the same filter with `include_archived` widened, so it costs nothing on a store
with nothing hidden and needs no new state. Measured on the store that started the confusion: `dado` holds 3 tickets,
all archived, and previously printed `No tasks found matching filter criteria` - byte-identical to an empty store.

That message is why this was mistaken for a broken store during `GB-347` and written into the task description as an
environment defect. It was a filter with no disclosure, and the cheapest possible fix was to disclose it.

ALREADY DONE, verified 2026-11-10 from inside miter: storypole list prints "17 archived ticket(s) hidden by this view; --include-archived lists them", so an all-archived store no longer reads as an empty one.

RE-CHECKED 2026-11-12 and the claim still holds: core_cmds/mod.rs:120 prints N archived ticket(s) hidden by this view; --include-archived lists them.
